# English spelling and grammar suggestions (ADR-0004). See tests/fixtures.rs for the
# notation: ⟦…⟧ spelling, ⟪…⟫ grammar; nothing else in a line may be flagged.
# The dialect is British unless @dialect says otherwise.

# The specimen's deliberate mistakes.
Spelling: I will ⟦recieve⟧ the letter ⟦tomorow⟧.
Grammar: This is ⟪a⟫ apple. ⟪Their⟫ is a problem with ⟪the the⟫ sentence.

# Ordinary prose stays quiet.
A writer sits down with nothing but a blank page and a quiet mind. The page fills slowly, one sentence at a time, and the sentences find their order.
Each heading level must be distinguishable by size, weight and spacing, and not by colour or small caps alone.
Text can be emphasised, strong, both, struck through, or contain inline code. Numbers in prose: 1,234 words, 3.14, 2026.

# Opinionated rules are off: sentence-case headings, the Oxford comma either way, long
# sentences, wording judged boring, swearing.
A third-level heading
Bread, butter and jam. Bread, butter, and jam.
This sentence goes on for a long time because it has many clauses joined together with commas and conjunctions, and it keeps going well past the point where a style checker would complain about its length, which is a matter of style and not a mistake that anyone needs to be told about while writing.
It was very good and very nice, and its colour was free of charge.
Damn, the deadline is tomorrow.

# Smart punctuation and its straight forms are both left alone.
Typed with smart punctuation on, these should read: “quoted”, it’s, 10–12, a pause — then … and so on.
Straight forms are deliberate: "quoted", it's, 10-12, a pause -- then ... done.

# British by default; American spellings are flagged, and the other way round.
The colour of the organisation's favourite theatre was grey.
The ⟦color⟧ of the organization's ⟦favorite⟧ ⟦theater⟧ was ⟦gray⟧.
@dialect american
The color of the organization's favorite theater was gray.
The ⟦colour⟧ of the ⟦organisation⟧'s ⟦favourite⟧ ⟦theatre⟧ was ⟦grey⟧.
@dialect british

# Capitals (acronyms), single letters and words with digits are never flagged.
IJMES, UNESCO and the ALA-LC tables are acronyms.
Write x or y, then the 3rd and the 21st item.

# Of a possessive only the word is flagged, so Add to dictionary adds the word.
⟦Taymiyya⟧’s student wrote extensively, and ⟦Qayyim⟧'s too.
@personal Taymiyya bismillah
Taymiyya’s student wrote extensively, and TAYMIYYA in capitals.
Bismillah opens the sentence, and bismillah is lower case.
⟦taymiyya⟧ in lower case is not the entry.
@personal

# Grammar suggestions.
⟪Its⟫ a common mistake.
I ⟪could of⟫ done it better.
We need to ⟪discuss about⟫ the problem.

# The switches.
@off grammar
I will ⟦recieve⟧ the letter. This is a apple.
@on
@off spelling
I will recieve the letter. This is ⟪a⟫ apple.
@on
